newsitem.title: USA: Ionica sells $200 mln in junk bonds and warrants.
newsitem.headline: Ionica sells $200 mln in junk bonds and warrants.

text.p: The following 144a offering of units, including high-yield bonds and contingent warrants from Ionica Plc was priced in the U.S. on Thursday via BT Securities Inc.
Ionica provides local and long distance telephone service to residential and small business customers in the U.K. using wireless technology.

NOTES: Market sources said the deal was completed as an offering of units that included the bonds and contingent warrants for five percent of the company. The warrants are contingent on the completion of an initial public offering within 12 months.

Proceeds of the offering were $200.289 million. The face value of the bonds was $420 million, sources said. The company may call up to 35 percent of the bond issue at 115 if it completes an equity offering within three years, they added.
